tldr: Mars in the 10th house: drive becomes personal through career, visibility, reputation, authority, ambition, and public direction.
body:
With Mars in the 10th house, this part of you pushes through career, visibility, reputation, authority, ambition, and public direction. Mars describes drive, anger, courage, desire, defense, and the will to act. In practice, this brings attention to the work, responsibilities, goals, and public roles that shape how you are seen.

When this placement is supported, your direction can become more visible, accountable, and real. Mars can become courage, initiative, stamina, desire, and the ability to move when something matters.

When it is strained, achievement or approval can start carrying too much of your identity. The harder pattern can show up as reactivity, conflict, burnout, or acting before the real target is clear.
gift: courage, initiative, stamina, desire, and the ability to move when something matters expressed through career, visibility, reputation, authority, ambition, and public direction.
challenge: reactivity, conflict, burnout, or acting before the real target is clear around career, visibility, reputation, authority, ambition, and public direction.
